description: Run a web search and return ranked results. Supports locale targeting (a language code like 'en', a language-region tag like 'en-US', or 'all'), pagination via 'page', safe-search filtering, and restricting results to a recency window via 'time_range'. By default the service rotates across its engines and falls back on failure; set 'engine' to pin one engine with no fallback. Returns the result list, the engine that served it, query suggestions, and any spelling correction. An empty result list means the engine answered and found nothing; such a search is not charged. Requires a Geonode API key, sent as the X-Api-Key header.

engine.description: Pin the search to one engine, with no fallback to any other. Omit to let the service rotate across its engines and fall back on failure, which is what most callers want. Pinning trades reliability for control: a single engine having a bad moment becomes your error instead of being routed around.
engine.title: Search engine

locale.description: Locale tag: a language code ('en'), a language-region tag ('en-US'), or 'all'. Omit for no preference; duckduckgo is then searched in en-US.
locale.title: Locale

page.description: Result page to fetch. Without `engine`, 1 to 9. With `engine` set, the pinned engine's own limit applies instead: duckduckgo 5, naver 9, yahoo 9.
page.title: Result page

safe.description: Safe-search filtering level. Accepted values: "off", "moderate", or "strict".
safe.title: Safe-search level

time_range.description: Restrict results to a recency window. Accepted values: "day", "week", "month", or "year". Some engines honour fewer: yahoo day/month/week. Pinned to one of them, any other value is rejected; without `engine`, that engine is skipped.
time_range.title: Time range

name: search
title: Search the web
